app_name: NetPulse MikroTik Centralized Management & Real-Time Monitoring
theme: Modern RouterOS v7 WebFig / Winbox Dark Theme

visual_enhancers.status_badges: High contrast status badges with glowing indicator dots

grids_and_layouts.table_density: dense tabular data layouts with sorting, filtering, and quick action buttons

accessibility.contrast: WCAG AA compliant dark contrast with clear focus rings
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive elements include data-testid attributes (kebab-case)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a full-stack MikroTik Centralized Management & Monitoring app with FastAPI backend and React frontend.
Implement real MikroTik RouterOS API connectivity (librouteros / ros-api) with fallback simulation demo routers.
Create centralized monitoring dashboard with real-time CPU, Memory, Uptime, Interface Traffic widgets.
Build device & group management, RBAC/tenant management, threshold alarms, Telegram Bot alerts configuration.
Implement Winbox-inspired read/write configuration tabs: Interfaces, IP Addresses, Routes, Firewall, System Resources, Logs, Terminal CLI emulator.
Ensure Ubuntu 24.04 easy installation instructions and setup script are provided.
Use dark slate gray theme (#0b0f17, #131b2e, #38bdf8 accents), dense tables, and high contrast badges.
Add test-id attributes to all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
universal_guidelines: Do not use transparent backgrounds without blur or scrim.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use dense tabular layouts and dark winbox aesthetics.
